identity.title: Safety Data Sheet for Sodium Hydroxide Solution, 50%

scan.summary: This is a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) prepared by the chemical supplier Northwest Alkali Products for sodium hydroxide solution 50% (w/w), following OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard. It describes the product's hazards (skin corrosion, eye damage, corrosive to metals), required protective equipment, handling procedures, and emergency response measures. As a supplier document, it is not Cascade's to fix; it establishes what Cascade must do when using this chemical.
scan.freshness_note: This SDS was revised March 18, 2024, which is current as of September 25, 2026 (within two years). No newer version is apparent from the document.

facts.affects: Identifies the source of the chemical Cascade handles; affects procurement and emergency contact procedures

facts.value: Skin corrosion Category 1A, serious eye damage Category 1, corrosive to metals Category 1; signal word DANGER
facts.quote: Classification: Skin corrosion, Category 1A (H314); Serious eye damage, Category 1 (H318); Corrosive to metals, Category 1 (H290). Signal word: DANGER
facts.affects: Determines what personal protective equipment, engineering controls, and emergency procedures Cascade must provide and follow
Establishes the airborne exposure limit Cascade must not exceed in the workplace; triggers need for monitoring and respiratory protection

facts.value: Emergency eyewash and safety shower within 10 seconds of work areas
facts.quote: emergency eyewash and safety shower within 10 seconds of work areas
facts.affects: Requires Cascade to install and maintain eyewash and shower stations accessible to workers handling this chemical

facts.value: Unneutralised product is corrosive hazardous waste (RCRA D002)
facts.quote: Unneutralised product is a corrosive hazardous waste (RCRA D002)
facts.affects: Cascade must manage disposal according to RCRA hazardous waste rules, not as ordinary waste
Triggers DOT reporting requirements if 1,000 lb or more is spilled or released
Requires CERCLA reportable quantity notification to EPA if 1,000 lb or more is released to the environment
